data.body:
[P2] Recheck request history before deleting the label

The history guard runs only during planning, before the separate label API calls. Two overlapping runs can both approve removing the old request; the first finishes, a maintainer reapplies `changes-requested` after reviewing, and the second executes this unconditional DELETE. That removes the newer request despite its timestamp being after the triggering event. Carry the original event cutoff into the apply phase and recheck the latest label application after adding `needs-review`, immediately before deletion, preserving any newer request. Add a regression test that reapplies the label between planning and deletion.
